base_member_text: triDxDy_mgpu_cuda_v1 back substitution 남측 송신(L307)이 myFx_T/myFy_d 가 아닌 Y1_d(1,Jbeg) 를 송신 — v1(비주기 이중 아님)에서 Y1_d 사용은 v2 와의 혼선으로 보이나 의도 미확정
audit_member_text: In multi-GPU native solver v1, the y backward substitution produces `myFy_d` (kernel call around L289-L291), but the south-boundary send copies from `Y1_d(1,Jbeg)` at L307. Y1_d belongs to the periodic two-solve path and is not assigned by triDxDy_mgpu_cuda_v1, so nonperiodic MGPU y back-substitution can transmit stale/uninitialized data instead of the solved myFy_d boundary.

base_member_text: 교차라인 결함 후보: periodic_triDy_cusparse 의 L1056-1057 'Arow(1+(i-NGhost-1)*...)=0.0_SP' 가 do 루프 밖에서 루프변수 i 를 사용 — 직전 루프(L1046-1052) 종료 후 i 값에 의존하는 단일 원소 대입으로, 전체 행 경계 0 설정 의도(비교: triDy_cusparse_init_kernel L1777-1778 은 j==Jbeg/Jend 조건으로 처리)와 불일치로 보임
audit_member_text: `periodic_triDy_cusparse` copies Drow to D1row and then executes two boundary coefficient assignments using scalar `i` outside any DO at L1055-L1057. The preceding DO leaves i at its terminal value; with conventional Iend=Mloc-NGhost this row-index expression advances one batch beyond the allocated `(Mloc-2*NGhost)*(Nloc-2*NGhost)` vectors, so the writes can be out of range and do not clear every batch boundary.

base_member_text: 교차라인: triDy_init_kernel·triDy_cusparse_init_kernel 의 COUPLING 분기 IF(IN_DOMAIN_SOUTH)...ELSEIF(IN_DOMAIN_SOUTH) (L1660-1668, L1755-1763) — CPU etauv_solver.F 과 동일한 도달불가 ELSEIF(IN_DOMAIN_NORTH 오기로 보임) 재현
audit_member_text: Every coefficient initializer repeats the CPU guard defect: `tmp2.NE.0.0_SP.OR.MASK_d(I,J).GT.0` precedes division by tmp2 in native x, cuSPARSE x, native y (L1669-L1672), and cuSPARSE y kernels. An active cell with tmp2==0 takes the division path. The y initializers also repeat `IF(IN_DOMAIN_SOUTH)` followed by `ELSEIF(IN_DOMAIN_SOUTH)` (native at L1658-L1664 and again in the cuSPARSE-y block), making the Jend/north coupling correction unreachable.

base_member_text: ESTIMATE_HUV_GPU 의 인자 ISTEP 는 'integer :: ISTEP' (L89) — intent 미지정; TriSolver==1 첫 할당 경로는 Allocated_1 을 .True. 로 만들지 않아(L112-120, 플래그 설정은 TriSolver==0 쪽 L106 만) 매 호출 재할당 시도 가능
audit_member_text: TriSolver allocation state is inconsistent. Under `.NOT.Allocated_1`, the TriSolver==0 branch sets `Allocated_1=.True.` before allocating matrices, while the TriSolver==1 branch allocates Arow/Brow/Crow/D1row/Drow but never sets the flag (L118-L137). A later ESTIMATE_HUV_GPU call with TriSolver==1 re-enters allocation on already allocated arrays. The nearby comment says not to try solver 1 (L170-L173), but the runtime branch remains callable.

base_member_text: HUV_BAR_KERNEL 의 WaveMakerCode 정수(4,5,6,7,8,9,10,12)와 CPU 판 문자열(WK_REG/WK_IRR/JON_2D/JON_1D/TMA_1D/WK_TIME/WK_DATA2D/LEFT_BC_IRR)의 대응표는 이 파일에 없음 — mod_cuda 나 초기화 코드 소재로 추정
IF(tmp2.NE.0.0_SP.OR.MASK_d.GT.0) (L1490,1566,1671,1765)의 .OR. 조건은 CPU 판과 동일 — tmp2=0·MASK>0 시 0 나눗셈 가능
COUPLING 분기의 IN_DOMAIN_WEST/EAST/SOUTH (L1465-1473 등)는 use 목록에 없음 — COUPLING 정의 시 컴파일 의존 미확정
streamID·cusparseh·gtsv_buf·TriSolver·BlockDim* 등은 mod_cuda 소재 — 이 파일에 정의 없음

audit_member_text: The TriSolver==1 dispatch calls `triDy_cusparse` regardless of PERIODIC in the ESTIMATE_HUV_GPU branch around L169-L177. A distinct `periodic_triDy_cusparse` implementation exists at L982-L1195 but has no call in this file; therefore PERIODIC is passed into coefficient initialization yet the periodic solver is bypassed for solver 1.

Native Thomas forward sweeps test only `A != ZERO` and then divide by `1/A-C_previous` (x at L1804-L1806, the combined x solver later in the same block, and analogous y kernels). They do not test the actual pivot denominator, so a nonzero A does not prevent a singular or near-singular elimination step.
Periodic Sherman-Morrison scale factors divide by `1-(C_end*Y2_begin-A_beg*Y2_end)` in native paths around L772-L802 and cuSPARSE paths around L1137-L1188 without a zero/conditioning check.

The module uses `USE GLOBAL, ONLY:` at L18-L24 but COUPLING kernels reference IN_DOMAIN_WEST/EAST/SOUTH and spherical code references R_earth later. Those names are not visible in the explicit GLOBAL list; whether PARAM or another conditional module supplies them must be checked in the build configurations.

Several MPI backward messages send `2*Mloc` or `2*Nloc` elements after copying only the first buffer column (for example L307-L311 and corresponding v2/triDy routines). Receivers use only the first column for the backward value. The extra stale payload is ignored locally but the oversized protocol is undocumented and increases coupling fragility.

The post kernel evaluates Utotal/Fr at L2001. Fr is derived from imported GRAV and MinDepthFrc immediately before this chunk; positivity is assumed, so a zero lower depth bound would leave a division-by-zero path.
